The Dow Jones, by contrast, remained essentially flat with 15 stocks up and 15 down, reflecting divergent momentum across market segments. CoreWeave climbed 19.28 percent on strong results that gave the AI trade a boost, per the Wall Street Journal. Lumentum rose 13.63 percent as its stock surge gave further momentum to the optical-networking trade, according to MarketWatch. Ciena added 11.49 percent with no specific catalyst reported by tracked outlets.

Materials and Consumer Discretionary sectors lagged, declining 1.11 percent and 0.88 percent respectively, while Communication Services fell 0.38 percent. Cencora fell 5.9 percent with no specific catalyst reported. First Solar declined 5.87 percent following analyst calls covered by CNBC. Mercado Libre slid 5.76 percent with no reported catalyst. Axon Enterprise fell 5.74 percent on analyst estimates and ratings per the Wall Street Journal. Charter Communications dropped 4.74 percent with no specific catalyst.
